newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Portugal spread seen widening with Bund.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Portugal spread seen widening with Bund.

text.p: The following is the daily forecast for spreads in the Portuguese bond market based on a poll of four banks and one brokerage.

Poll covers spreads between the February 2007 Portuguese cash bond (OT) and the German and Spanish equivalents, together with the spreads between the Portuguese 10 and two-year bonds. --------------------------------------------------------------
Min spread Avge Max vs previous close
Key factors likely to affect market:

-The 10-years seen easing as the market waits for news on the new French government and its budgetary policy, with the row between the Bundesbank and Bonn over gold rumbling in the background. The weakness of the escudo will prevent any steepening of the curve.
Note: YLDS3 is still calculated on basis of Feb 06 bond.
